Lemma
[Local Orthonormal Frames for the Normal Space]

↗ def:normal-space ↗ prop:adapted-orthonormal-frames-immersed

For an immersion $F:M^n\to \widetilde M^m$, $n\le m$ and every point has a neighborhood with smooth sections $N_1,\ldots ,N_{m-n}$ of $F^*T\widetilde M$ whose values form an orthonormal basis of $N_xM$ at each $x$.
Proof

↗ prop:adapted-orthonormal-frames-immersed \sketch Use Proposition 5 and take $N_j=E_{n+j}$. Orthonormality makes these sections normal to the span of the first $n$ vectors; expanding any normal vector in the full orthonormal frame forces its first $n$ coefficients to vanish.

□
